in_marathi.name: Shaquib
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shaquib हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Shaquib is derived from the Arabic word 'shukr' meaning 'thankful' and 'ibn' meaning 'son'. The name is believed to signify a child who is a gift from God, a blessing bestowed upon his parents.
